summary: Rearrange project files according to the project structure
description: Moves files of the project into the folders given by rules, layout and assets in the project file. Paths in .include/.incbin in the sources and the project file are updated. A backup is made first in .vcbackup/.

These stay where they are: programs of the source groups, start program, disk files, editor files (without a folder for studio in layout), .vctest files (except in a folder with the role tests), the project file, README, LICENSE, CHANGELOG and files already in the target folder. If the target is taken, the file is skipped.
After moving, a check build rebuilds the project and compares the result files with those from before. If they differ, the command ends with exit code 1.

args.name: project
args.help: Project folder or .vcprj file. The default is the working folder.

options.help: Show planned moves and sources to be adjusted. Changes nothing.
Run without asking. Without a terminal, --yes is required, otherwise the command changes nothing.
Also rearrange files in subfolders, not only those in the project folder.
Do not adjust paths in .include/.incbin in the sources.
Skip the check build before and after moving.
Folder of the hardware database (data) for the check build. If it is not found, the check build is skipped with a note.
options.default_text: VC_DATA, otherwise next to the program or in the working folder

notes: If the check build differs: copy the files back from .vcbackup/<time>/ and move the files named in moves.txt back. The last five backups are kept.
If there are no files to move, the command reports "Nothing to organize."

exit.1: error, missing confirmation without a terminal, or different check build
